name: underchat_authenticator
description: Underchat Authenticator for WhatsApp Web authentication.

scripts.build:dev: UNDERCHAT_AUTHENTICATOR_CHANNEL=dev tsc --noEmit && UNDERCHAT_AUTHENTICATOR_CHANNEL=dev electron-vite build --mode development
scripts.build:prod: UNDERCHAT_AUTHENTICATOR_CHANNEL=prod tsc --noEmit && UNDERCHAT_AUTHENTICATOR_CHANNEL=prod electron-vite build --mode production
scripts.package:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --config.directories.output=release/dev && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel dev
scripts.package:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --config.directories.output=release/prod && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel prod
scripts.package:win:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run cert:win:self-signed && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --win nsis --config.directories.output=release/dev && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel dev
scripts.package:win:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run cert:win:self-signed && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --win nsis --config.directories.output=release/prod && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel prod
scripts.package:linux:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --linux AppImage deb --config.directories.output=release/dev && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel dev
scripts.package:linux:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --linux AppImage deb --config.directories.output=release/prod && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel prod
scripts.package:mac:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --mac dmg zip --universal --config.directories.output=release/dev && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel dev
scripts.package:mac:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:prod && UNDERCHAT_REQUIRE_MAC_SIGNING=true node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --mac dmg zip --universal --config.directories.output=release/prod && node scripts/sync-manager-downloads.mjs --channel prod
